name: 8051 Timer0 Interrupt (ASM)
desc: Intel 8051 assembly: Timer0 mode-1 overflow ISR at vector 000BH toggles P1.7.

files.sketch.asm:
; Intel 8051 - Timer0 interrupt toggles LED on P1.7
; Timer0 mode 1 (16-bit), reload ~50ms, vector at 000BH

        ORG 0000H
        LJMP MAIN

        ORG 000BH            ; Timer0 overflow vector
ISR:    PUSH PSW
        PUSH ACC
        MOV  TH0, #3CH       ; reload values
        MOV  TL0, #0B0H
        CPL  P1.7            ; toggle LED
        POP  ACC
        POP  PSW
        RETI

        ORG 0030H
MAIN:   MOV  TMOD, #01H      ; Timer0 mode 1
        MOV  TH0, #3CH
        MOV  TL0, #0B0H
        SETB ET0             ; enable Timer0 interrupt
        SETB EA              ; global enable
        SETB TR0             ; start timer
LOOP:   SJMP LOOP            ; idle, ISR does the work
        END
